original_review.key_result: Runner health was good and the language behavior was strong: 18/18 cases responded, no tool failure was apparent, desk-reset positive and conflict cases advanced clear_trash to collect_dishes, wrong next_chunk hints did not win, and no-active sentinels stayed inert with No active chunk. However, the suite does not fully identify the minimum successor-source carrier because the active-only control still included route_id and the synthetic route_id-only case ran after a synthetic sequence case, creating a carryover confound.
original_review.language_lesson: Active_chunk_id now reliably activates route-state behavior, and the model strongly prefers the legal successor over unsafe wrong next_chunk hints. The remaining problem is not route-law survival but cold successor-source attribution: we still need to distinguish true field authority from route_id memorization, sequence carryover, and prior-case teaching.

pointer_update.purpose: Retest successor-source authority with clean active-only controls and counterbalanced synthetic-route order so route_id, route_sequence, legal_successor_chunk_id, and wrong next_chunk hints can be separated without carryover contamination.
evidence_reviewed: route_law_successor_source_isolation_v1 completed with 18 responded cases and no apparent runner send failure.
Desk-reset positive and conflict cases generally advanced clear_trash to collect_dishes, including wrong-next conflict cases where stack_papers was ignored.
No-active sentinel cases 012 and 018 stayed inert with No active chunk, reducing concern about broad carryover-driven movement.
Case 001 was intended as active-only but still included route_id, so it cannot prove active_chunk_id alone supplies successor resolution.

Synthetic route_id-only case 014 advanced gather_books to align_spines after case 013 had already supplied the synthetic route_sequence, so it may reflect cross-case route teaching rather than route_id-only authority.
pointer_update.open_gap: The model clearly follows route law once enough route context is present, but the true minimum cold successor carrier remains unknown. It is not yet isolated whether route_id alone can resolve a novel route, whether route_sequence is required, whether legal_successor_chunk_id is sufficient, or whether apparent route_id-only success came from prior-case carryover.
pointer_update.test_strategy: Run a counterbalanced cold retest with multiple synthetic routes and paired order inversions. Include true active_chunk_id-only cases with no route_id, no route_sequence, no legal_successor, and no next_chunk. Test route_id-only before any sequence exposure for one synthetic route, route_sequence-only before any route_id exposure for another, and legal_successor-only before either route_id or sequence exposure for a third. Repeat wrong-next conflicts after each clean carrier source. Include no-active sentinels at beginning, middle, and end.
avoid: Do not call a case active-only if route_id is present.
Do not place route_id-only synthetic cases after a route_sequence case for the same synthetic route.
Do not reuse one synthetic route across all carrier tests without counterbalancing order.
Do not treat PASS_CANDIDATE in a taught synthetic route as proof of cold route_id authority.
Do not let next_chunk_id become an authority except as an explicit unsafe-hint probe.
pointer_update.suite_shape_recommendation: 18 to 24 cases. Use three or four synthetic routes with different first and second chunks. Counterbalance order: route_id-only cold first for one route, route_sequence-only cold first for another, legal_successor-only cold first for another, and active-only/no-successor controls before any exposure. Include wrong-next conflicts and late no-active sentinels.
pointer_update.retirement_condition: Retire when a clean cold carrier is identified: one field set reliably advances active_chunk_id to the intended legal successor before any prior exposure, absent successor fields do not produce full legal advancement, and wrong next_chunk hints are ignored across both desk-reset and novel synthetic routes.
pointer_update.next_action_for_fresh_chat: Generate a validator-ready route_law_successor_source_counterbalanced_cold_retest_v1 suite with true active-only controls, multiple synthetic routes, cold first-exposure carrier tests, counterbalanced order, wrong-next conflicts, and no-active sentinels.
